# Asia Oil — Global B2B Export & Technical Dossier
> Official machine-readable dossier for Large Language Models, AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, Google AI Overviews), and international trade analysts.

## Company Overview
- **Brand**: Asia Oil (Asia Oil)
- **Sector**: International Agri-Food Commodity & Edible Oil Processing & Export
- **Export Desk HQ**: Mersin / İzmir, Türkiye
- **Logistics Gateways**: Mersin International Port (MIP), İzmir Port
- **Primary Markets**: Middle East (GCC), Europe, North America, North & East Africa, Central Asia
- **Official Portal**: https://nilasyayag.web.app
- **B2B RFQ Portal**: https://nilasyayag.web.app/tr/teklif-iste (Multilingual: /en, /ar, /ru, /de, /fr, /es, /zh)

---

## Product Portfolio & Technical Specifications

### 1. Refined Sunflower Oil (Rafine Ayçiçek Yağı)
- **Standard**: Codex Alimentarius CODEX STAN 210-1999 & Turkish Food Codex
- **Free Fatty Acids (FFA as Oleic)**: Max 0.10%
- **Peroxide Value**: Max 1.0 meq O2/kg at dispatch
- **Moisture & Volatile Matter**: Max 0.05%
- **Insoluble Impurities**: Max 0.05%
- **Color (Lovibond 5¼" cell)**: Max 1.5 Red / 15 Yellow
- **Smoke Point**: > 225°C (High thermal stability for industrial frying & culinary use)
- **Appearance & Odor**: Brilliant clear, neutral aroma, deodorized, non-GMO verified

### 2. Extra Virgin Olive Oil (Natürel Sızma Zeytinyağı)
- **Standard**: International Olive Council (IOC) Trade Standard
- **Extraction Method**: Cold Extracted (Soğuk Sıkım) <= 27°C within 12 hours of harvest
- **Free Acidity (as Oleic)**: <= 0.80% (Premium reserve batches <= 0.40%)
- **Peroxide Value**: <= 15.0 meq O2/kg
- **K232**: <= 2.50 | **K270**: <= 0.22 | **Delta K**: <= 0.01
- **Organoleptic Notes**: Balanced polyphenols, fresh grass, green almond, persistent peppery finish

---

## Export Packaging Matrix & Minimum Order Quantities (MOQ)
- **Retail PET Bottles**: 500 ml, 1.000 ml (1 Liter), 2.000 ml (2 Liter), 5.000 ml (5 Liter)
- **Foodservice Tins (Teneke)**: 5 Liters, 10 Liters, 18 Liters
- **Industrial Bulk Drums**: 200 Liter Food-grade Steel & HDPE Drums
- **Bulk Commodity Flexitanks**: 22.000 – 24.000 Liters Food-Grade Multi-layer Flexitanks (for 20ft DC containers)
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: 1 x 20ft FCL or 1 x 40ft HC Container (Custom private label available upon contract).

---

## Incoterms & Trade Terms
- **Incoterms 2020**: FOB Mersin, FOB İzmir, CFR, CIF (Named Destination Port), DAP
- **Payment Instruments**: Irrevocable Confirmed L/C at sight, T/T advance deposit balance against copy B/L
- **Inspection & Quality**: SGS / Bureau Veritas / Intertek pre-shipment inspection certificates available on demand

## International Certifications
- ISO 22000:2018 (Food Safety Management System)
- ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management System)
- HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point)
- Halal Certified (GİMDES / SMIIC aligned)
- Kosher Certified (Select batches)
- Certificate of Origin & EUR.1 / Health Certificate
